# European External Action Service (EEAS)

> > Official website of the European External Action Service, the EU's diplomatic service managing foreign policy, international relations, and global partnerships under High Representative Josep Borrell.

The EEAS coordinates EU diplomatic missions worldwide, manages special representatives for key policy areas like human rights, oversees military operations, and maintains delegations in over 140 countries. The service implements EU foreign policy decisions and represents European interests globally.

## Key Topics

- Josep Borrell (High Representative)
- EU Foreign Policy & Diplomacy
- Human Rights & Democracy Promotion
- EU Special Representatives
- Eastern Partnership
- Western Balkans Accession
- EU Delegations Worldwide
- Military Operations (IRINI, Sahel)
- Gender Equality in Diplomacy
- EU-India Relations
- Libya Arms Embargo
- COVID-19 & WHO Cooperation
- Sahel Security & Development
- Albania & North Macedonia Accession
